scenes.textDe: Schau mal aus dem Fenster! Draussen fällt weisser Schnee auf die Berge.
scenes.textEn: Look out the window! Outside white snow is falling on the mountains.

scenes.textDe: Mia der Fuchs zieht ihre warme rote Mütze und zwei Handschuhe an. Jetzt ist ihr schön warm.
scenes.textEn: Mia the fox puts on her warm red beanie and two mittens. Now she is nice and warm.

scenes.textDe: Mia zieht ihren Holz-Schlitten den weissen Hügel hinauf. Schritt für Schritt!
scenes.textEn: Mia pulls her wooden sled up the white hill. Step by step!

scenes.textDe: Huiii! Mia saust mit dem Schlitten durch den Schnee. Das macht riesigen Spass!
scenes.textEn: Wheee! Mia zooms on the sled through the snow. That is huge fun!
scenes.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 400 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='400' height='300' fill='#CFE8FF'/><path d='M0 130 Q200 195 400 268 L400 300 L0 300 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/><path d='M70 155 Q105 162 125 170' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/><path d='M55 180 Q95 186 115 194' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/><g class='kg-bob' transform='rotate(16 210 185)'><rect x='152' y='198' width='96' height='12' rx='5' fill='#C98A55'/><path d='M148 224 L254 224 Q266 224 262 206' fill='none' stroke='#8D5B3E' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/><ellipse cx='164' cy='186' rx='24' ry='12' fill='#E2703A'/><ellipse cx='146' cy='182' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFF8F0'/><ellipse cx='202' cy='174' rx='24' ry='24' fill='#E2703A'/><rect x='184' y='152' width='38' height='9' rx='4' fill='#2A9D8F'/><ellipse cx='208' cy='132' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#E2703A'/><path d='M184 118 Q208 92 232 118 Z' fill='#E63946'/><circle cx='208' cy='96' r='7' fill='#FFFFFF'/><circle cx='218' cy='128' r='3.5' fill='#2F2419'/><ellipse cx='230' cy='135' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#2F2419'/><path d='M214 142 Q222 148 228 140' fill='none' stroke='#2F2419' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/></g><circle cx='140' cy='218' r='7' fill='#FFFFFF'/><circle cx='120' cy='208' r='5' fill='#FFFFFF'/></svg>

scenes.textDe: Oh je! Mia schaut auf ihre Pfote. Ein roter Handschuh ist weg!
scenes.textEn: Oh dear! Mia looks at her paw. One red mitten is missing!

scenes.textDe: Piep, piep! Ein kleiner Vogel ruft neben der Tanne. Da liegt der rote Handschuh im Schnee!
scenes.textEn: Cheep, cheep! A little bird calls next to the pine tree. There lies the red mitten in the snow!
scenes.svg: <svg viewBox='0 0 400 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><rect width='400' height='300' fill='#CFE8FF'/><path d='M0 212 Q190 190 400 212 L400 300 L0 300 Z' fill='#FFFFFF'/><rect x='288' y='185' width='20' height='34' fill='#7F5539'/><polygon points='242,192 298,118 354,192' fill='#2D6A4F'/><polygon points='254,154 298,92 342,154' fill='#40916C'/><ellipse cx='258' cy='234' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#E63946' transform='rotate(-15 258 234)'/><circle cx='244' cy='224' r='7' fill='#E63946'/><g class='kg-float'><ellipse cx='222' cy='168' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#3B82F6'/><circle cx='236' cy='160' r='11' fill='#3B82F6'/><polygon points='246,158 258,162 246,166' fill='#FFD166'/><circle cx='238' cy='158' r='2.5' fill='#2F2419'/></g><g class='kg-bob'><ellipse cx='120' cy='210' rx='30' ry='34' fill='#E2703A'/><rect x='98' y='178' width='44' height='11' rx='5' fill='#2A9D8F'/><ellipse cx='124' cy='152' rx='32' ry='26' fill='#E2703A'/><path d='M98 132 Q124 104 150 132 Z' fill='#E63946'/><circle cx='124' cy='108' r='8' fill='#FFFFFF'/><circle cx='134' cy='148' r='3.5' fill='#2F2419'/><ellipse cx='146' cy='156' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#2F2419'/><path d='M132 162 Q138 168 145 162' fill='none' stroke='#2F2419' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/></g></svg>

scenes.textDe: Danke, lieber Vogel! Mia zieht ihren Handschuh wieder an und trinkt zu Hause warmen Tee.
scenes.textEn: Thank you, dear bird! Mia puts her mitten back on and drinks warm tea at home.

questions.questionDe: Welche Farbe hat die Mütze von Mia?
questions.questionEn: What color is Mia's winter hat?
questions.answerDe: Die Mütze von Mia ist rot.

questions.questionEn: What does Mia lose in the snow?

questions.questionDe: Wer hilft Mia, den Handschuh wieder zu finden?
questions.questionEn: Who helps Mia find her mitten again?
questions.answerDe: Ein kleiner blauer Vogel neben der Tanne hilft ihr.
questions.answerEn: A little blue bird next to the pine tree helps her.

questions.questionDe: Womit saust Mia den weissen Hügel hinunter?
questions.questionEn: What does Mia zoom down the white hill on?
questions.answerDe: Sie saust mit dem Schlitten (der Schlitten).
questions.answerEn: She zooms down on the sled (der Schlitten).

questions.questionDe: Was spielst du am liebsten draussen im Schnee?
questions.questionEn: What do you like to play outside in the snow the most?
questions.answerDe: Zum Beispiel Schlitten fahren oder einen Schneemann bauen!
questions.answerEn: For example sledding or building a snowman!
